identity.name: Daily Provisions Dupont Circle
identity.notes: The live official location page lists the Dupont address and daily 7 AM-9 PM hours and links pickup/delivery to Thanx location 14651. The linked ordering surface explicitly states Pickup at DuPont Circle.

sources.title: Daily Provisions Dupont Circle official location
sources.excerpt: Live official page identifies 1601 Connecticut Ave NW, Washington, DC 20009, daily 7 AM-9 PM, and links pickup/delivery for location 14651.

sources.title: Daily Provisions Thanx ordering - DuPont Circle
sources.excerpt: Live linked ordering menu explicitly identifies Pickup at DuPont Circle and fully enumerates Crullers, Breakfast, Bakery & Sweets, Sandwiches, Soup & Salads, Roast Chicken, Mains, Sides, Provisions, Coffee & Tea, and Beverages with direct Contains statements on applicable products.

sources.title: Daily Provisions Allergen Guide dated June 25, 2026
sources.excerpt: Restaurant-issued one-page grid covers milk, egg, peanut, tree nuts, wheat, soy, fish, shellfish, and sesame. O means removable and X means non-removable.

sources.title: Daily Provisions catering FAQ cross-contact statement
sources.excerpt: The catering FAQ states that catering items are produced in the same kitchen and there is always a risk of cross contamination.

proposedChanges: Replace the mixed 87-row baseline with the complete 92-product current Dupont food and nonalcoholic catalog from the live linked Thanx surface.
Collapse duplicate category presentations and size-only beverage presentations; remove modifier, operational, and description-fragment artifacts.
Apply both removable and non-removable positive claims from the official guide, preserve linked-vendor Contains statements, and union positives for the nine discrepant products pending Sol review.
Keep the catering cross-contact statement restaurant-level and scoped to catering; do not smear it into Dupont pickup product may-contain fields.
Recompute Ingredient Intelligence only after direct catalog and Sol conflict resolution are finalized.

findings.summary: Nine products have different positive-allergen sets between the current official guide and linked Dupont menu. No omission is treated as a negative; unions are retained pending Sol review.
Eleven frozen rows are modifiers, operational controls, or description fragments; three products are stale; repeated current presentations collapse to 92 unique products.
The official June 25, 2026 matrix was found and visually verified; it distinguishes removable (O) from non-removable (X) allergens.
